A furry ball-shaped '''creature''' lurked in the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. When the young [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]] explored the Shadowlands in search of [[Wasaka berry/Legends|wasaka berries]], the creature lunged at him. Lumpawarrump dove into a hollow log to hide, and the creature crashed into the side of the log.
